verified_2026_10_24.boundary_definition: Registered residence change across the boundary of a territorial unit; direct region observations are required.
verified_2026_10_24.scope_break_2001: Through 2000 only permanent residents. From 2001 foreigners with visas over 90 days and asylum included.
verified_2026_10_24.source_break_2005: Administrative Ministry of Interior records replace migration statistical reports.
verified_2026_10_24.territory: Yearly territorial classification follows January 1 of each year; series may be affected by changes.
verified_2026_10_24.census: Population balance series reset on censuses; do not derive migration from differences of population stocks.

indicator_population_definition: DEM0026B is explicitly labeled Počet obyvatel k 31.12.; DEM0026A Počet obyvatel k 1.1.; DEM0004 Střední stav obyvatel. Training output population uses DEM0026B of row year; only lagged population may enter forecast.

documentation.population_midyear: population at midnight June30/July1; unused as prediction target-year denominator
